measures.name: Bottom 20% Days to Final Median
measures.expression:
VAR TotalCenters =
   COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( Center ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Center Ranking Overall] ) ) )
VAR GroupSize =
   ROUNDUP ( TotalCenters * 0.2, 0 )
VAR BottomCenters =
   TOPN ( GroupSize, ALL ( Center ), [Center Ranking Overall], DESC )
RETURN
   AVERAGEX ( BottomCenters, [Days to Final Median] )
